messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered - GPU pool 'us-west-inference-pool-2' queue > 3k, backpressure detected, autoscaler at max. Severity: P2. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/queue-growth
sara: seeing huge queue growth and ~30% node flaps over the last 8m. autoscaler failed to add more nodes - hit instance quota?
lucas: confirmed - cloud quota for GPU region shows 0/2 remaining accelerators. API returns 429 on create.
ryan: logs show repeated CUDA/Xid=45 and kernel OOM on driver v495.71 on several nodes. That explains effective capacity drop.
sara: immediate impact: embedding batch jobs and long-run rerank pipelines saw 5-15s extra p50 and some 504s for big requests. No full customer outages reported yet, but latency spike for a few high-throughput tenants. @eve can you confirm customer noise?
eve: saw elevated alerts from tenant-rl-analytics and a single support ticket about slow embeddings. Not widespread but noisy for heavy jobs.
maria: marking action items: 1) stop non-essential batch jobs, 2) cordon noisy nodes, 3) attempt constrained scale-up in another region, 4) alert infra-driver team. Assigning ownership.
sara: doing step 1 now - sending kill signal to all low-priority batch queues.
lucas: running drain on suspected nodes with repeated Xid: `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
ryan: adding runtime thread: possible regression in driver rollover from 494->495, kernel OOMs appear after sustained large KV cache warmups. Suggest fallback to previous driver patch.
sara: deploy-bot: Initiating quota request to cloud provider for +4 GPUs in us-west, description: emergency autoscale quota bump for inference pools. Request id: Q-17832.
deploy-bot: Quota request submitted. ETA ~12-18m for approval in self-service portal, may be longer for manual review.
lucas: while quota comes through, propose temporary routing: route 20% of traffic to eu-west pool with lower load. Policy change will reduce p50 by offloading some heavy pipelines.
ryan: good plan. I'll open a canary route for rerank/embeddings: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/redwood/routes -d '{"route":"eu-west-canary","weight":20}'`
maria: also patch suggestion: rollback driver on nodes that keep Xid/OOM to 494. I'll prepare a hotfix plan but need infra signoff for node-level driver reflash.
sara: tracking live mitigation steps in incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incident/6239990001. Adding timestamps and impact summary.
eve: customer comms: drafting a short note: "We're experiencing increased latency for large-batch embedding and rerank jobs in us-west; mitigations are in progress." ETA 30m.
lucas: cordon + drain complete for 3 nodes. Found kernel logs with repeated stack traces: ```kernel: gpu0: NVRAM OOM after alloc 0x1f4000000
nvidia-driver: Xid 45, process run-worker pid=1478
```
ryan: opening infra-driver pager: @maria @lucas please provide core dumps and dmesg to runtime team channel. We need to check memory leak in driver NVKM allocations.
maria: runtime oncall acknowledged. Starting node reflashes to 494 where possible. Will hold one node to test rollback before mass rollback.
sara: autoscaler still at max - even if driver fixes free up capacity, we need to prevent immediate refill of low-priority queues. Setting autoscaler scale-in-protection for critical pools.
lucas: routing change applied, 18% traffic diverted to eu-west-canary. p50 dropped ~3s immediately.
eve: customer note posted to subscribed tenants, support triage monitoring.
ryan: local repro: running our stress-runner reproduces kernel OOM after ~6m. Attaching command: ```./stress-infer --model text-embed-25 --batch 64 --sequence 2048 --duration 10m```
sara: since quota might be slow, manual broker: reduce batching on large jobs by 30% across pool to lower memory pressure. Patching job configs now.
maria: rollback test node back to driver 494 successful, no Xid and stable for 8m. Proceeding with staged rollback for 6 nodes.
lucas: note: we observed two node flaps during rollback due to kubelet drain timeouts; increased eviction grace to avoid pod churn.
sara: update on customer impact: 12 high-throughput requests returned 504s during peak, ~200 tenants saw latency increase but only 3 filed support tickets. No SLO breaches for most customers yet.
eve: continuing to monitor support channels, escalation if more tickets emerge.
maria: rollback finished on 6/8 targeted nodes, health checks green, queue draining rate improving. Remaining two nodes still under maintenance.
ryan: runtime team proposes driver patch to fix NVKM leak, but requires kernel ABI check - will schedule a canary build and coordinate with release.
sara: mitigation summary: - throttled batch jobs - drained/cordoned noisy nodes - diverted traffic to eu-west - rolled back driver on most affected nodes - quota request in flight. Impact: transient latency and a few 504s for large batch requests.
lucas: next steps: follow up with cloud quota team, file bug with driver vendor, run extended soak in eu-west canary, and prepare post-incident RCA.
maria: handing off to night oncall @ryan for monitoring. Please keep incident channel updated and escalate if customer impact increases.
ryan: oncall ack. I'll keep checks running and push any regressions to paging. Good work team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 6239990001 status -> mitigated. Closed to live incident, follow-up RCA required.
